title: Had a dream once that involved a humming sound, a light, and a feeling/way of communication that I have never experienced til or since then.
content: Honestly it's kind of a long story, but it changed my beliefs about existence in the course of probably about 15 seconds. Just checking if anyone else has had this type of experience. Edit: I did make a long comment describing this situation, it just took me a day to get there so sorry.
